backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that stores contact form submissions in a map keyed by child+parent name, preventing duplicates, and exposes functions to submit and retrieve all submissions sorted by timestamp.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two address-display features (Contact section sidebar and Footer) to their implementing files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy' and mounts the React app via a root div and module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the full single-page layout by rendering Navbar, HeroSection, AboutSection, ProgramsSection, GallerySection, ContactSection, and Footer in order.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component displaying academy mission text, a highlighted mission statement box, and a 2×2 values grid with icons for Focused Training, Expert Coaches, Proven Results, and Holistic Development.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact/enrollment section with a react-hook-form validated form that submits to the backend canister, plus a sidebar showing phone, email, and the full academy address (Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004) with a MapPin icon.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with academy branding, smooth-scroll quick links, and a contact info column displaying the full address with a MapPin icon, phone, email, social media icons, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Renders a responsive photo gallery grid with six cricket academy images and a lightbox modal supporting next/prev navigation.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image, academy branding, tagline, CTA buttons for enrollment and about, and a stats row.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with logo, smooth-scroll nav links, an enroll CTA button, and a collapsible mobile menu.
Displays three tiered cricket coaching program cards (Junior Starter, Rising Stars, Elite Performer) with features, badges, and an enrollment CTA.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/clear functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query mutation hook for submitting the contact/enrollment form to the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, and defines CSS custom properties for a cricket-themed green and gold color palette in both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for gradients and text shadows.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM root.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom cricket brand colors (green/gold/cream), display/body font families, box shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes, while enabling dark mode via class and including typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 5) describing the Shri Balaji Cricket Academy static website, listing all implemented features (hero, about, programs, gallery, contact, navigation, theming, address display) with their requirement IDs and versions.
